nodes.guardrail: Before deepening economy and tech, verify that your defensive structure can handle early Reaper harassment; if not, prioritize building a Zealot or a Shield Battery at your natural.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition or if you detect early pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before expanding further, ensure you have sufficient defense against possible Reaper harassment; if your expansion is light or uncertain, prioritize building a Shield Battery or a Zealot at your natural.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Medivacs, Marauders) or if you face early pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before adding more Colossus or transitioning to High Templar, verify that your army composition can handle potential Siege Tank or Banshee threats; if not, prioritize building Observers for vision and keep your Colossus safe.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Siege Tanks, Banshees) or if you face a large push.

nodes.guardrail: Before adding High Templar or transitioning to a mixed composition, verify that your army can handle potential Battlecruiser or Raven threats; if not, prioritize building a few Stalkers or Phoenixes for anti-air and keep your Colossus protected.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Battlecruisers, Ravens) or if you face a large push.
